subject.title: fix(gateway): preserve pending replies on forced restart

question: Should OpenClaw change forced gateway restarts from immediate/no active-work wait to a bounded 5s best-effort drain before merge?
rationale: The diff fixes a real reply-loss path but changes an operator-visible force-restart contract that current CLI help and docs still describe as immediate.

options.title: Accept bounded force drain after proof
options.body: Require redacted live forced-restart proof and align CLI/docs wording, then treat the 5s best-effort drain as the intended force contract.

options.title: Keep force immediate
options.body: Preserve immediate forced restart semantics and solve pending replies through a different recovery or replay design.

options.title: Pause for broader restart policy
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide how it should interact with queued-message persistence and chat-initiated self-restart work.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded force drain after proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted live forced-restart proof and align CLI/docs wording, then treat the 5s best-effort drain as the intended force contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans gateway restart semantics and operator-facing docs, both areas present in steipete's adjacent history.
